groups.title: Index groups
groups.hint: The sections of the Indices board. Rename them in both languages, describe them, give each a colour, reorder them, or archive the ones you do not use.
groups.codeHint: Optional. Lower case letters, digits, dashes; made from the name when empty.
groups.codeTaken: That code is already in use
groups.archived: Group archived; its indices stay in their other groups
groups.memberCount: {count, plural, =0 {no indices} one {# index} other {# indices}}
groups.dragHint: Drag a row to reorder, or use the arrows. Membership is set on the board in edit mode and in the Add index wizard.
groups.emptyHint: Add the first group; the board shows one section per group.
groups.loadFailed: The groups could not be loaded.

wizard.title: Add index
wizard.created: Index {code} created with {count, plural, one {# observation} other {# observations}}
wizard.codeHint: Short and lower case, for example gfci. It becomes the last part of the page address under /indices/.
wizard.codeTaken: An index with this code already exists
wizard.codeInvalid: Two to twenty-four characters: letters, digits, dashes or underscores
wizard.statisticsHint: For national indicators: values are read from the series when no observations are published.
wizard.targetsSelected: {count, plural, =0 {No target linked} one {# target linked} other {# targets linked}}
wizard.pasteHint: A header row with country, year, rank, score (and optionally total). ISO3 codes or English country names; tabs are accepted.
wizard.uploadHint: The first sheet is read; the header row names the columns country, year, rank, score.
wizard.urlHint: A direct link to a CSV or XLSX file. Fetched once, within 20 seconds and 6 MB; the link is stored as the source of every row.
wizard.sourceUrlHint: Optional. Stored on every row as its source.
